# Measles Situation Report — MMWR Week 44, 2026 (week ending 2026-11-07)

## Summary
In MMWR week 44, 196 indigenous (U.S.-acquired) measles cases were reported, along with 2
imported cases. Indigenous cases for the year to date total 4,991, up 219.7% from 1,561 at
the same point in 2025. The 4-week trend is stable (614 vs 637 cases). Wisconsin (58) and
Pennsylvania (56) reported the most cases this week.

## Key figures
| Measure | Indigenous | Imported |
|---|---|---|
| Cases this week | 196 | 2 |
| Year to date | 4,991 | 82 |
| YTD same week 2025 | 1,561 | 127 |
| % change | +219.7% | −35.4% |

## Geographic distribution
Wisconsin (58), Pennsylvania (56), New York State (excl. NYC) (32), and Minnesota (20) led
this week. Pennsylvania has the largest YTD total (1,474). The District of Columbia
reported its first case of the year in week 41.

## Trend
Stable: 614 cases in weeks 41–44 compared with 637 in weeks 37–40.

## Data notes and limitations
NNDSS counts are provisional and subject to revision. The YTD total rose by 363 this week,
more than the 196 cases reported, because it includes late reports for earlier weeks.

## Recommended public health actions
- Promote MMR catch-up vaccination in affected communities.
- Issue clinician alerts on measles recognition, isolation, and testing.
- Support exposure notification and post-exposure prophylaxis.
